Triage: **queued & blocked** — `pm:queue` + `pm:blocked` + `domain:devx` (objectstack half lands in `scripts/` pin/refresh) + **`target:v17`** (board call: binary test passes — a published, GA-accepted authoring key is refused by the Studio designer today, category ① user-hit released-surface defect).

**Dedupe correction — the objectui half already exists; no split card created.** The card's 0-hit dedupe searched this repo only. In objectui:
- **objectstack-ai/objectui#4636** — exactly step 1 (pin/lockfile → 17.0.0 GA), open, assigned, with parked bump PR objectui#4639. `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#4636` appended to this card's body (write verified).
- objectui#4709 — a finding on the same subject, left to the `repo:objectui` seat to fold.

**Chain state, measured at grading time**: #4636 is itself blocked solely on **objectui#4648** (`needs-user-decision`, maintainer inbox — the GA authoring-surface question, recommendation A on the card). So the real bottleneck of this whole chain is one maintainer ruling; once #4648 is ruled and PR #4639 re-points and lands, this card unblocks mechanically (pin bump + `pnpm objectui:refresh`, gates `check:console-sha` / `check:objectui-pin-fresh`).

The filer's ordering warning stands: ⛔ never bump the pin before objectui main resolves 17.0.0 — that re-vendors rc.6 (#8051's loop).

Size/model suggestion once unblocked: S–M mechanical bump via the dedicated bump script, `opus`.

Verified against objectui `origin/main`, not the closure text alone: the GA ranges landed via the dependabot batch (objectui#4953–#4960 + `e609aac`), and the three reds that batch shipped were fixed/exempted by objectui PR #4978 (merged 10:25Z). Step 1 of this card — objectui's lockfile resolving `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0` — is delivered on main.

Card face re-verified before requeue: this repo's console pin still reads `665661ab` (pre-GA; measured in #9281 at 09:38Z today), so step 2 — bump the pin to a post-GA objectui SHA + `pnpm objectui:refresh` — remains the live work. `pm:blocked` removed; back in the queue (`target:v17` board item).

Dispatch notes: pin to an objectui SHA ≥ `195b9e4` (post-PR #4978) so the vendored console does not build from this morning's red window. That range also carries the `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST` hook (objectui#4854 / PR objectui#4927, merged 05:54Z), which #8134's framework half needs — landing this card is what unblocks #8134. Same-day churn: re-read the pin value on current `origin/main` at claim time.
